Reference ID: # --- v5 intake: post-Beta roadmap war room 2026-08-10. Rows below were agent-verified against source with file-path citations unless marked otherwise. Three claims flagged RE-VERIFY are NOT Commander-verified and gate real spend.

Name: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
Status vs as-built: VERIFIED-IN-DOCS - RELEASED 2025-12-09 (not draft). IDs ASI01-ASI10. NOTE the name is 'Agentic APPLICATIONS' not 'Agentic AI'. Extends not replaces the LLM Top 10 2025 and ships a formal mapping table.
Disposition: E-06/S-27 authors our control mapping. Our posture: STRONG on ASI06 (memory poisoning - our read-only/share-gated/CTE-containment memory is ahead of everyone surveyed) and ASI09 (informed-launch consent). GAPPED on ASI02/03/05 (containment), ASI08 (audit authenticity), ASI04 (supply chain). STATE ASI07 as out of scope (single-plane, no agent-to-agent) rather than leaving it silent.

Name: jingkaihe/matchlock
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - containment LEAD. MIT. Firecracker microVM; programs nftables ITSELF via netlink (pkg/net/nftables.go) so egress-through-proxy is a deployment property not a runbook step; synchronous allow/block/mutate hook over a Unix socket (pkg/policy/network_callback.go); Import(io.Reader) for air-gapped images. RISKS: single maintainer (497 of ~516 commits), 6 months old, self-labeled experimental, hooks cover HTTP/HTTPS ONLY (raw TCP passthrough uninspected), .deb does not bundle a guest kernel.
Disposition: B-040 / v1.1. RE-VERIFY binary + guest-kernel footprint against the OI-4 150MB cap BEFORE committing - if it does not fit, the whole v1.1 shape changes.

Name: ironsh/iron-proxy
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - pair with MATCHLOCK. Apache-2.0, single static Go binary. Best external-decision seam found: grpc transform to an ARBITRARY endpoint returning TRANSFORM_ACTION_REJECT, fail-closed on error/timeout. Also enforces per-server MCP tool allowlists with argument constraints AND filters tools/list so denied tools never appear to the agent. NOT a sandbox - it does not program netfilter itself, so enforcement is runbook unless paired.
Disposition: B-040 / v1.1. Borrow the tools/list filtering pattern regardless of adoption - it removes a class of ASI01 goal-hijack pressure for free.

Name: OpenHands/software-agent-sdk
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - layer-2 reference integration #1. MIT. CORRECTION: OpenHands/OpenHands has PIVOTED to an Electron control center; the agent lives here now. Block-and-wait is a first-class REMOTE protocol - POST /confirmation_policy, POST /security_analyzer, POST /respond_to_confirmation; agent halts in WAITING_FOR_CONFIRMATION and resumes only on an HTTP call. MCP-only achievable (empty built-in tools list). LiteLLM base_url so no vendor lock. Healthiest bench surveyed (462 contributors).
Disposition: B-041 / v1.2. Integration is a CLIENT not a patch - zero fork.

Name: andrewyng/openworker
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - layer-2 reference integration #2. MIT. External block-and-wait via GET /v1/inbox + POST /v1/inbox/{id}/resolve; also injectable approver= constructor param defaulting to _deny_all (fail-closed). permissions.py is worth reading as prior art - rejects any command containing shell operators BEFORE prefix-matching argv, explicitly because 'git status' would otherwise auto-approve 'git status && rm -rf ~'. RISKS: 14k stars against 130 commits / 8 contributors / 3 weeks old; TWO default-on cloud egress paths (AWS API-Gateway WSS relay + telemetry).
Disposition: B-041 / v1.2. RE-VERIFY the egress defaults and the bus factor before depending on it.

Name: nearai/ironclaw
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - a COMPETING governance plane, not an adoptable harness. Apache-2.0 OR MIT. Its InvocationFingerprint = SHA-256 over canonicalized (scope, capability, estimate, input) - the same anti-swap property our gateway enforces, independently arrived at. Capability-based not tool-based; WASM sandbox; approvals resolve via chat channels and WebUI with NO external HTTP approvals API. Seams are Rust dyn Traits in a composition root, so substituting our plane means a fork. 884 crates, 1482 open issues.
Disposition: STUDY, DO NOT ADOPT. Validates our design by convergence. Read its approval_interaction and capability_authorization crates before authoring the v1.1/v1.2 ADRs.

Name: microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit (re-read v5)
Status vs as-built: RE-READ 2026-08-10 - the sobering row. Independently arrived at ~5 of our 7 controls INCLUDING the credential-broker property we treat as differentiating (agent_os/credential_vault.py - agents never receive resolved secret values; opaque handles; uniform DenyReceipt so existence is not disclosed). Audit = SHA-256 content hash + previous_hash chain + HMAC-SHA256 with verify_integrity(). Also has what we lack: RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization for action-bound approvals, 4-tier privilege rings (runtime containment), SBOM/CodeQL/fuzzing CI, published EU AI Act + NIST AI RMF mappings.
Disposition: E-06/S-21 cross-check. POSITIONING CORRECTION: our genuinely unmatched control is the AIR-GAP POSTURE, not the individual controls. Plan the pitch accordingly.

Name: denoland/clawpatrol
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - the finding that exposed our containment gap. MIT. Enforces at the WIRE (WireGuard join / Linux netns / macOS NetworkExtension) so an agent that shells out to curl or psql is STILL governed - contrast ours, which holds only while the agent chooses to call the gateway. HCL rules with CEL conditions over protocol-aware facts (sql.verb, k8s.resource, http.method) where ours sees an opaque command string. Human approver blocks with HMAC request_fingerprint anti-swap. NO audit integrity (every merkle/hash-chain hit is in vendored third_party/tailscale).
Disposition: Read at B-040. Its enforcement model is the argument for v1.1; its lack of audit integrity is the argument for why we still win on evidence.

Name: Agent-Field/agentfield
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - ahead of us on ONE axis and it matters. Apache-2.0. Audit integrity is W3C Verifiable Credentials with ed25519.Verify over canonical bytes, so a third-party auditor verifies an exported provenance bundle OFFLINE with bundled DIDs - without touching their control plane or trusting their database. Our unkeyed chain is only verifiable by someone we grant read access to our own store. Also: W3C DID per agent with did:web revocation. NO credential broker; approval is a status transition not an invocation-anchored block-and-wait.
Disposition: B-042 / E-06 S-28 - this is the design to beat for audit-chain external verifiability.

Name: callstack/agent-device
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - closes B-008/REQ-011, NOT-STARTED with no named prior art since v3. MIT, 4k stars, active. Accessibility-tree snapshots (not screenshots) with a typed schema; broad backends (xctest/android/harmonyos-arkui/macos-helper/linux-atspi/web); ships a REAL stdio MCP server; pure local bridge, no cloud or model dependency, no analytics SDK. Refs are POSITIONAL not stable - by written contract (ADR-0014) - guarded instead by a ref FRAME with a monotonic epoch.
Disposition: B-008 / v1.4+. BORROW ADR-0014's ref-frame expiry at the side-effect seam regardless of adoption - it binds consent to a specific reviewed observation, strictly stronger than our invocation-anchored idempotency key.

Name: lahfir/agent-desktop
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - EVALUATED AND NOT PICKED for B-008. Apache-2.0. macOS-only in practice: crates/windows/src and crates/linux/src are 6-file empty stubs whose own tests are named snapshot_surfaces_fail_closed_until_windows_implements_them. No MCP server (Phase 4 planned). Strong where it works - refs qualified by snapshot id, identity evidence re-verified at action time, fails closed with STALE_REF/AMBIGUOUS_TARGET.
Disposition: BORROW ONE THING: the disposition{delivery: delivered|not_delivered, retry: safe|unsafe} axis on every structured error. Our Run sequencer and reaper infer terminal state from error codes; a delivery axis would let a resumed Run distinguish 'never reached the broker' from 'may have executed'. Real DUR-2/3/4 correctness win.

Name: unworld11/manycode
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - the session-sharing primitive for cockpit@1. MIT (tiny repo, 8 stars - read for MECHANISM not maturity). Raw PTY bytes both directions = full remote control.
Disposition: v1.4+ with the mobile PWA. LEARN FROM THEIR FAILURE: their relay cannot attribute input frames per joiner, so their approval gate degrades to best-effort over relay - build per-joiner attribution into the protocol from day one.

Name: mattermost/mattermost
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - the layer-3 messaging pick. Disposition: v1.4+ - govern it as a CONNECTOR, do not clone it. Two runtime phone-homes (EnableSecurityFixAlert, EnableDiagnostics), both default-true and both disable-able for a clean air-gapped server.

Name: Evokoa/pgGraph
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - highest-signal find for B-024. Apache-2.0 (GitHub reports NOASSERTION due to reflowed license text - not a real problem but it will trip license scanners). Postgres extension via pgrx, PG13-18. VERIFIED zero ML dependencies - full crate list is roaring/xxhash-rust/bitvec/bincode/crc32fast/memmap2/serde/thiserror/serde_json. Disposition: B-024 / v1.4+. THREE ADR CAVEATS: superuser=true trusted=false; NO prebuilt binaries (we own the per-OS x per-PG-major build); and traversal does NOT enforce RLS - RE-VERIFY this, because a traversal surfacing rows the ReadForAgent CTE would hide is a governance hole, not a perf note.

Name: KittenML/KittenTTS
Status vs as-built: NEW v5 - the voice pick on size/license/CPU. Apache-2.0 on BOTH code AND weights (verified separately - the usual trap). nano-0.1 onnx = 23.8MB verified via HF API. CPU-only: plain onnxruntime, GPU is a separate opt-in requirements file, NO PyTorch anywhere. English-only, TTS-only. CORRECTION: the README's '25MB int8' is FALSE - all published ONNX are fp32.
Disposition: v1.4+ as an ADR-0052 companion artifact (~100-150MB with the onnxruntime wheel). Needs a small patch or HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 for air-gap since get_model.py calls hf_hub_download unconditionally. Multilingual fallback = MOSS-TTS-Nano (20 languages, Apache-2.0 weights) at 235MB + pinned PyTorch + a pynini build problem. AVOID pocket-tts: MIT code but CC-BY-4.0 WEIGHTS, which creates an attribution obligation in the shipped product.

Name: OpenClaw/Moltbot containment ecosystem (openclaw, ironclaw, nanoclaw x2, NVIDIA/NemoClaw, nullclaw, ClawX, clawpatrol, Windows Sandbox guides, managed hosts Clawly/AtomicBot/Klaus)
